description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thammennawa, Nuwaragampalatha D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110186
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details (mostly by "The State"), and classification. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
